trackedIssues.11: enum : ulong config entries fail to sync. YAVSOS has no ulong-backed enum (checked 2026-10-27); stays unaffected while that holds.
trackedIssues.12: Synced client changes relayed to other clients when the server lacks the mod. Checked 2026-10-27 (detached reading): YAVSOS not affected. Receiving is blocked by ServerPolicyRoutedGuard/IsServerSender (a relayed message keeps the original client ID), and PolicyHost.OnRemoteChanged also requires a server; sending happens only with LockSharedPolicy off and is dropped. Re-check if the sender guard changes or ServerSync is upgraded.
